notes: No show is built into AniBox any more. Ask first (Settings → Locks) now starts empty on a new install, so AniBox fits anyone's library; your own list stays exactly as it was (if you never changed it, One Piece keeps asking first, saved as your own setting). A library is no longer counted as anime because of a show's name (it still is when its folders match MyAnimeList). Settings now says that the One Piece fan-wiki pictures are the only source made for one show. Texts and examples no longer name a specific show.
